# Fake EDA executable

`fake-eda-tool.mjs` is a process-level fixture for integration and browser
tests. It accepts the argv generated by production adapters and writes minimal
parseable files. `FAKE_EDA_MODE` covers `success`, `fail`, `timeout`,
`partial`, and long-running `cancel` behaviour.

It is intentionally stored below `test/fixtures/fake-tools`. The production
admin API rejects any tool configuration pointing here unless
`NODE_ENV=test`; this directory must never be copied into a production tool
installation or used as evidence of a real EDA run.
